scenes.visual_description: Max against a plain warm cream background, leaning very slightly towards the camera, ordinary ears.
scenes.camera: Locked static medium shot, no camera movement.
scenes.dialogue: Max: "Go on, tell me the gossip."
scenes.subtitle: Go on, tell me the gossip.

scenes.visual_description: Max on the same plain background, now with enormous cartoon ears roughly the size of dinner plates.
scenes.character_action: Max holds completely still, ears enormous.
scenes.camera: Locked static medium shot, no camera movement.
scenes.subtitle: I am all ears.

scenes.visual_description: Close on the same plain background, Max unchanged with the huge ears, a flat unimpressed expression.
scenes.character_action: Max holds the pose and does not move.
scenes.camera: Locked static medium shot, no camera movement.
scenes.dialogue: Max: "This is not what that means, is it."
scenes.subtitle: This is not what that means, is it.

scenes.visual_description: Max on a plain warm cream background with ordinary ears again, relaxed.
scenes.camera: Locked static medium shot, no camera movement.
scenes.dialogue: Max: "All ears just means listening carefully."
scenes.subtitle: All ears = listening carefully.

scenes.visual_description: Max on the same plain background, a small friendly expression.
scenes.camera: Locked static medium shot, no camera movement.
scenes.dialogue: Max: "Tell me everything, I am all ears."
scenes.subtitle: Tell me everything, I am all ears.
